data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Restaurants, type destination, pick suggestion, expand more filters, tick one filter, apply) with the right location and filter parameters, but it adds a conditional "More restaurants in <destination>" step that the true workflow lacks, and it describes the filter as a checkbox where the true action clicks a label.
